name: btn-creative-right
title: Arrow Reveal Button
description: A pill-shaped link button that starts white with a black dot and the word About. On hover the dot grows into a solid gold fill, the label slides across and a right arrow joins it.
use: A secondary About or link button should feel playful without taking up much room.
avoid: The label and gold fill are hardcoded, and the hover-only reveal leaves touch users without a second state.
a11y: It is a plain div with cursor-pointer, so it cannot be tabbed to, activated from the keyboard, or announced as a button. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A white rounded pill with a small black dot near its left end and the word About in bold black, standing on a dark stage. Hovered, the same pill becomes olive-gold with white About text and a white right arrow sitting side by side.
behaves: Hovering swells the little black dot until it fills the pill in gold while the first label slides right and fades. A matching white label and arrow slide in from the right, and moving away reverses the whole sequence.
customise: The label, dot size, fill colours and timing are written into the markup; it takes no props, so every change is a file edit.
weight: light: One pill, one arrow icon and a handful of CSS transitions.
issues: The control is a div, so keyboard and screen-reader users cannot activate it.
Frames 2 and 5 catch dark text over a half-filled pill, briefly low in contrast.
polishWhy: Crisp pill and a satisfying fill-and-arrow reveal; both resting and hover states look finished.
